jobs.title: Senior Thermal Analysis Engineer
jobs.description_text: About this Role As the Senior Thermal Analysis Engineer , you will serve as a key member of the vehicle engineering team to develop and maintain thermal system architectures and collaborate cross-functionally with hardware, production, software, and mission ops to ensure vehicle health and performance through all mission phases. Your work directly influences design and performance of Varda’s spacecraft and will often flex between quick evaluations and high-fidelity analysis. You will also contribute to thermal modeling and data processing workflows to build more efficient and robust systems as we scale in vehicle cadence. A proactive problem-solving approach and commitment to meeting tight schedules are critical to supporting Varda's goals of expanding in-space manufacturing. We are in the mission of developing engineering systems for life-changing products in microgravity for patients on Earth and looking for skilled and driven teammates to help us get there. In this fast-paced, dynamic environment, you'll work closely with engineering, production, and quality teams to source, evaluate, and manage suppliers of machined parts used in spacecraft assembly, propulsion systems, and other space hardware. You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end procurement process—from identifying potential suppliers and negotiating contracts to monitoring delivery timelines and ensuring parts meet rigorous quality standards. As Varda continues to innovate and expand, your ability to source parts that adhere to strict performance and reliability criteria will directly contribute to the success of our mission to bring space-based manufacturing into the next era. This is a full-time, exempt position located in our El Segundo headquarters. Your work will be instrumental in ensuring the success of our Winnebago-class spacecraft and future ambitious projects. This is your opportunity to contribute to technologies that are defining the future of space exploration and make an impact that reaches far beyond the stars. Responsibilities Design, build, and operate test systems for spacecraft avionics components and assemblies to fully exercise components during environmental stress testing and component acceptance testing. jobs.title: Space Systems Engineer, Flight Safety
jobs.description_text: About this Role Varda is seeking a Space Systems Engineer to fill a flight safety analyst and reentry compliance role. Joining our Mission Assurance team, you will produce the Flight Safety Analysis and regulatory strategy required for FAA Part 450 and Range Safety licensing. This is a highly cross-functional role that bridges the gap between complex engineering trades and regulatory approval. From defining safety-critical verification artifacts during design to supporting live on-console operations, you will ensure our flight hardware is verified and our reentry methodologies are mathematically sound. Responsibilities Perform flight safety analyses for each mission, with a focus on failure mode trajectory modeling and debris field containment. Execute the technical regulatory strategy, Methods of Compliance, and safety cases for FAA launch and reentry authorizations. Complete vehicle-level functional hazard analyses (FHA) and failure mode and effect analyses (FMEA). Act as the Flight Safety responsible engineer during mission rehearsals and live recovery operations. Establish technical safety limits and mission rules for real-time on-console operations. Responsible for vehicle-level deliverables to regulatory organizations, in the service of mission reentry licenses and authorizations. jobs.title: Thermal Hardware and Test Engineer II
jobs.description_text: About this Role As the Thermal Hardware and Test Engineer II , you will be responsible for hardware design, build, and test for ground and spacecraft thermal and fluid systems. This is a hands-on role, spanning mechanical, electrical, fluid, and control disciplines with opportunities to innovate at every stage: concept, fabrication, instrumentation, and commissioning. You will be responsible for developing active and passive thermal control systems, such as heat pipes, pumped fluid loops, thermal switches, etc. as well as the supporting infrastructure for testing and data-processing. Day-to-day responsibilities will be focused in thermomechanical hardware and system sizing, CAD design, fabrication, testing, instrumentation, and troubleshooting. Successful candidates thrive on solving hard problems, adapting to dynamic requirements, and collaborating across multiple domains. You will gain significant ownership, see your contributions rapidly come to life, and help us uphold the highest standards of performance, reliability, and safety in our hardware. If expanding the capability of in-orbit manufacturing to serve life-changing products to patients sounds intriguing, this role is for you. This role is open at the Eng II level, with levels determined based on candidate experience. jobs.description_text: About this Role As the Thermofluids Engineer II , you will be responsible for driving fluid system design for thermal management on the spacecraft through analysis, test, and validation.
